entities.name: Abhaya of Upatissa Nuwara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abhaya (Sinhala:අභය) was king of Upatissa Nuwara from 474 BC to 454 BC. He succeeded his father Panduvasdeva after being chosen by his siblings as the oldest among them to be the next monarch of Upatissa Nuwara. He was succeeded by his brother, Tissa.
